notes:
Tally Suite — reorganized, plus a new Sales GST Summary:

• Tally Suite is now grouped into three sections: Tally GST Services, Tally Bank Statement Services, and Tally Input/Output Services — so the right tool is easier to find at a glance.

• New: Sales GST Summary. Pick a date range and get a client-wise (party-ledger-wise) breakdown of Taxable Value, CGST, SGST and IGST, pulled straight from Tally's own Sales vouchers — no manual export needed. Any sale with no GST ledger on it is called out separately as Non-GST Sales, so nothing gets miscounted.

• Minor polish: sign-in screen layout balance, topbar sizing, and a fixed icon/text overlap on a few input fields.
